passages.context: Charles's translation depicts destructive spirits afflicting Noah's descendants, Noah petitioning God, Mastema asking that some spirits remain under him, and God permitting one tenth to remain while consigning nine tenths to condemnation. This English translation is not an original-language control.

passages.context: Charles's translation explicitly says Abram looked and beheld the stars at 14.5, places the sacrifice in the middle of the month at 14.10, reports sunset already completed at 14.13 and 14.17, and retains 'on that day' at 14.18. The rewriting neither dates the star sight nor inserts an explicit day break before it.
